email.subject: Quick fix for Mane Street Co's site
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I checked Mane Street Co's website and noticed two things likely costing you bookings: there's no way to book an appointment online, and no click-to-call button, so mobile visitors looking for a fast appointment have to hunt for your number or leave. The site also doesn't list your hours, which adds friction for anyone deciding whether to walk in.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what I'd fix and why? No pitch, just the findings.

Alex
